# Save a search as an always-on program, preview image per device
### New
- **Save a search as the always-on program:** on the "Search" tab, pick a frame and press "📌 Save as always-on program". The frame then shows the results in its always-on program alongside its other sources. Sources have a new kind "Search (text)" (`suche=summer 2022 beach`, with weight `suche=grandma:60`). Results are remembered for one hour; a failing search never disturbs the other sources. If a frame has no sources of its own yet, Frameside asks first, because it will show only these results afterwards.
- **Preview image in the device list:** every device that is currently showing photos has a small picture of the current photo. The player reports the photo's ID with its regular poll.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
